rows.title: The high-risk plants set's guides describe the journey the service serves
rows.detail: The set's own record of documentation drift treats a document stating something the service does not do as a defect, because a second, false specification gets read as though it were current. The served-surface reference, the guide to the set's features, the guide to the journey's flow and the table of each page's copy state all describe the journey as it stood before this work: the dashboard and the picker, how a page ends and what the view header carries, the sections, task rows, Back rules and caption map, and each page's copy state. Bringing each one to what the service does, and writing into the set's documentation that a guide changes in the same increment as the behaviour it describes, puts the drift right and stops it returning.
acceptanceCriteria: The set's served-surface reference describes the notification dashboard and the address picker as the service serves them, the picker showing eight addresses a page (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/README.md:81, 83, 91)

The guide to the set's features describes how a page ends, and what a draft's and a submitted notification's view header carries, as the service has them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/features.md:95, 178)

The guide to the journey's flow lists the journey's sections, its task rows in the order the overview lists them, where Back goes on every journey page, and which pages carry which caption, as the journey's flow has them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/journey-flow-and-gates.md:21, 63, 111, 248)
The table of each page's copy state lists every page in the set with the state of its copy review (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/copy-status.md:3)

The set's documentation states that a guide describing a behaviour of the journey changes in the same increment as that behaviour (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/backlog-extras.json increment docs-drift-sweep)
notes: One slice: the four guides describe one journey and a reader checks them together, so correcting them apart would repeat the same walk of the journey four times. Claims behind it: repo-plantsfrontend-p18-001, -002, -006, -075, -090, -108, -116, -125, -155, -189.

Already sits in inc-278, which absorbed inc-279 on the last combine review; the combiner keeps inc-278 and its theme recorded-decisions-plants. inc-278 also carries req-2482 from the plants specification area, whose criteria this draft leaves untouched.

The guides read the overview, page order, pickers and view header as the split-off overview-and-review, consignment-parties and manage-notifications branches leave them, so the row builds once those land, as inc-278 already depends.
The set's testing guide is left alone: it is the split-off test-hygiene branch's to change.

The consignment contact page's return-control wording, which the features guide records as that page's exception, changes with the page on the split-off consignment-parties branch, which already holds that requirement in its pickUp.

The drift this programme does not change (finished entries, the entry-guard entry, the registration-module and empty-folder wording, the guides that disagree about flow-only keys and captioned sections) is out of scope and gets no criterion here.
